offline.bannerA11y: You are offline. The app is showing saved data and changes need an internet connection.

signIn.title: Welcome to Kameti
signIn.subtitle: Enter your mobile number. We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS.

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{phone}}.
verify.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.

profile.title: What's your name?
profile.subtitle: Committee members will see this name.

home.title: My committees
home.emptyBody: Start your own committee, or ask an organizer to add your mobile number to theirs.

form.name: Committee name
form.memberCountHint: Between 2 and 50. The committee runs for one month per member.
form.payoutSameDay: Same day as the due date (day {{day}})
form.orderMethod: How will the payout order be decided?
form.methodRandomHint: The app draws the order fairly. Every member can see the result and when it happened.
form.methodManualHint: You decide who gets paid in which month.
form.methodChoiceHint: Members pick a free month in the app. You can assign months for anyone without the app.
form.includeOrganizerHint: You'll pay every month and get one payout, like everyone else.
form.potBody: {{pot}} goes to one member each month

detail.notFound: This committee doesn't exist or you no longer have access to it.
detail.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its member list will be removed. This can't be undone.
detail.draftNotice: This committee hasn't started yet. Members and details can still change.

members.title: Members
members.includeMeHint: Adds you to the member list. Turn off if you only organize.
members.emptyBody: Add the people who will pay into this committee.
members.removeBody: They will no longer be part of this committee.
members.lockedNotice: This committee has started, so the member list is locked.

form.name: Name
form.phoneHint: They'll sign in with this number to see the committee.

contacts.title: Add from contacts
contacts.permissionBody: Kameti needs access to your contacts so you can pick members instead of typing their numbers. Only the people you select are added. Your contacts are never uploaded.
contacts.permissionDeniedBody: To pick members from your contacts, allow Kameti to access contacts in your phone's settings. You can also add members by typing their number.
contacts.emptyBody: Only contacts with a Pakistani mobile number can be added.

invite.body: {{organizer}} has added you to the committee "{{committee}}" ({{amount}} a month, {{count}} members) on the Kameti app.
invite.bodyGeneral: Join the committee "{{committee}}" ({{amount}} a month, {{count}} members) on the Kameti app.
invite.signInWithPhone: Install Kameti and sign in with your number {{phone}} to see your turn and payments:
invite.signIn: Install Kameti and sign in with the mobile number the organizer added, to see your turn and payments:

states.errorBody: Please check your connection and try again.

validation.phone_invalid: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number, like 0300 1234567.
validation.name_too_long: Name can be up to 60 characters.
validation.committee_name_too_long: Name can be up to 60 characters.
validation.description_too_long: Description can be up to 500 characters.
validation.amount_range: Enter an amount between Rs 1 and Rs 10,000,000.
validation.payout_day_after_28: The payout day must be on or before day 28.

errors.network: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
errors.otp_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.sms_failed: We couldn't send the SMS. Check the number and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.committee_full: This committee already has all its members.
errors.committee_not_draft: This committee has started, so members can't be changed.
errors.committee_locked: This committee has started, so its terms can't be changed.
errors.turn_out_of_range: That turn number doesn't exist in this committee.
errors.duplicate_phone: This mobile number is already in the committee.
errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.start_month_in_past: The first month can't be in the past. Choose this month or a later one.
errors.profile_incomplete: Please add your name in Settings first.
errors.not_organizer: Only the organizer can do that.
errors.organizer_phone_not_supported: Your number isn't a Pakistani mobile, so you can't be added as a member.
errors.member_count_below_members: There are already more members than that. Remove some members first.
errors.member_count_below_turns: Some members have turns beyond that number. Change their turns first.
errors.contacts_failed: Couldn't read your contacts. Please try again.
